provenance.note: Visual derivative; source library art is not an archive measurement. Source scale and placement are scenario choices.

master.scale_basis: SCENARIO visual sizing; not a measured robot dimension

checks.engine_scale_calibration: NOT_RUN; 1 m Blender FBX calibration passed
checks.non_manifold_visuals: See per-part counts; open panels are not dynamic collision geometry

limitations: Tripo six-wheel candidate has the wrong wheel arrangement; native NASA Curiosity source is the delivered master. Source arm/mast pose is preserved; dynamic joint behavior remains unverified.
NASA source provides diffuse/AO art, not calibrated instrument optics or measured material channels.

export_settings.obj: raw metres +X/+Y/+Z, no baked axis change
export_settings.lod_files: Separate FBX files; import LOD1/LOD2 explicitly; no automatic LOD-group claim
export_settings.material_binding: Connect BaseColor as sRGB; ORM/roughness/metallic/normal as linear; choose NormalDX for Unreal, NormalGL for Blender/glTF; engine binding untested

library.license: NASA Media Usage Guidelines; third-party/identifier restrictions remain

input.prompt: Realistic Mars science rover, exactly six independent metal wheels, three wheels on each side, exposed rocker bogie suspension. Rectangular low insulated chassis, off-white panels, graphite mechanisms, restrained red accents, bronze metal wheel rims. Tall camera mast with separate pan and tilt head, two forward stereo camera eyes. Five-link folded robotic arm at front with shoulder elbow wrist joints and round contact science turret. Each wheel and steering knuckle, suspension member, mast head and arm link an editable separate solid, assembled neutral pose with visible gaps at moving joints. Scientific aerospace construction, physically plausible panel seams and bolts, clean silhouette, moderate dust. No astronaut, no terrain, no platform, no scenery, no text, no logos. One complete vehicle.

pivot_inspection.method: Rotate separate wheel/rotor visuals by 90 degrees; check origin stays fixed; inspect renders

rejected_candidate.reason: Tripo wheel layout did not match six-wheel brief; preserved as original output, not used by master.blend
